advisory.finding: The assertion `assert recorder.wrapped is dc_backend.sanitizer` is a tautology: `recorder` is constructed one line earlier as `RecordingSanitizer(dc_backend.sanitizer)`, so `recorder.wrapped` is always that exact object and this line can never fail. scenarios: A future reader may believe the `is` check guards against the wrong sanitizer being exercised, when only the `fit_comment_calls` non-empty check actually does.
